snippet.title: The Deriver launch trailer
snippet.description:
A Doom gameplay mod with a condensed arsenal. Starring the enigmatic rival of the Artificer.

https://combine-kegan.itch.io/deriver

Trailer music is For Endless Fight III, the NES version by MiniMacro Sound
https://minimacro-sound.itch.io/mega-man-zero-8-bit

Maps used:
Suspended in Dusk (sid.WAD)
Scorching Earth (SCORCH.WAD)
Nostalgia 2 (Nost2.WAD)
Countdown to Extinction (TickTock.WAD)
Newgothic Movement 2 (NGmvmt2.WAD)


You can also support this mod and the others I've been working on here:
https://www.patreon.com/c/CombineKegan
https://ko-fi.com/combinekegan
